name: Religion pressure: engine signatures and unaffiliated reset diagnostics

steps.code: GameConfiguration.SetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES',true); GameConfiguration.UpdateEnabledMods(); if GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES')~=true and GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES')~=1 then error('official Heroes mode not enabled') end; return 'official Heroes mode enabled'

condition.code: local bridge=ExposedMembers.JAC_RP_HeroUI; return bridge~=nil and bridge.OriginBuilding~=nil and bridge.UnitInfo~=nil and bridge.Schedule~=nil

steps.code: if GameConfiguration.GetValue('JAC_AUTOTEST')==1 then if not ExposedMembers.JAC_ReligionPersistence or ExposedMembers.JAC_ReligionPersistence.Rules().REVIVAL_COOLDOWN_TURNS~=1 then error('test revival deadline SQL not loaded') end end; if GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES')~=true and GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES')~=1 then error('official Heroes mode required') end; if not Game.GetHeroesManager() or not GameInfo.HeroClasses then error('official Heroes data did not load') end; if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local n=0; for row in GameInfo.JAC_RP_Religions() do n=n+1; for _,tag in ipairs({row.Name,'LOC_JAC_RP_PUBLIC','LOC_JAC_RP_UNDERGROUND','LOC_JAC_RP_LOST','LOC_JAC_RP_SCRIPTURE','LOC_JAC_RP_REVIVE','LOC_JAC_RP_APPLIED','LOC_JAC_RP_PENDING'}) do local t=Locale.Lookup(tag); if t==tag or t=='' then error('missing localized text '..tag) end end end; if n~=20 then error('placeholder count '..n) end; return '20 placeholders and state text localized'

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p~=nil and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: if Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=0 then error('wrong local founder') end; local p=Players[0]; local settler=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units.UNIT_SETTLER.Index then settler=u; break end end; if not settler then error('missing founding settler') end; UnitManager.RequestOperation(settler,UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY); return 'capital requested'

local p=Players[0]; local c=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); if not c then error('native holy city missing') end; local custom=GameInfo.Religions.RELIGION_CUSTOM_1; if not custom then error('native custom religion slot missing') end; p:GetReligion():SetHolyCity(c); Game.GetReligion():FoundReligion(0,custom.Index); Game.GetReligion():AddBelief(0,GameInfo.Beliefs.BELIEF_CATHEDRAL.Index); local found=false; for _,r in ipairs(Game.GetReligion():GetReligions()) do if r.Religion==custom.Index then found=true end end; if not found then error('native placeholder not founded') end; return 'native placeholder religion founded'

local c=Players[0]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); c:ChangePopulation(5-c:GetPopulation()); local cr=c:GetReligion(); local r=GameInfo.Religions.RELIGION_CUSTOM_1.Index; cr:SetAllCityToReligion(-1); cr:AddReligiousPressure(0,r,10000,-1); if cr:GetNumFollowers(r)~=5 then error('probe fixture must start with five religious citizens') end; return 'one argument prepared'
return 'one argument before: '..ExposedMembers.JAC_RP_PressureProbe()

local cr=Players[0]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity():GetReligion(); local r=GameInfo.Religions.RELIGION_CUSTOM_1.Index; cr:RemovePressureOneReligion(r); return 'one argument core followers='..cr:GetNumFollowers(r)
return 'one argument after subtraction: '..ExposedMembers.JAC_RP_PressureProbe()
